name: Interview
description: An interview or conversation with one main guest: who they are, what they said by topic, and notable quotes.

sections.title: Summary
sections.instruction: Summarise the interview in one paragraph: who was interviewed (as introduced in the recording), the purpose, and the main takeaways.

sections.title: Key Points by Topic
sections.instruction: Group what the interviewee said by topic, in the order discussed, with [mm:ss] for each topic.

sections.title: Notable Quotes
sections.instruction: Copy up to eight memorable or important statements word for word from the transcript, with [mm:ss]. Do not paraphrase inside quotation marks.

sections.title: Facts and Figures
sections.instruction: List any numbers, dates, names or facts the interviewee stated, with [mm:ss].

sections.title: Follow-ups
sections.instruction: List anything that was promised, left open or needs checking after the interview, with who said it when stated.
